description: Look again at one target from a search. Given a vague or wrong target and what the user wants instead — a specific model ("the S25 Ultra"), a version ("the latest one"), or a capability or market ("one with hardware AV1 encode", "a Chinese vendor doing the same thing") — returns up to 5 real, current products with a reason for each, grounded in a live web search. FREE: no credit is taken. Use it before charting, to chart the right thing. It refines one row; to screen a whole market for a patent, use claimhit_search.

instruction.description: What the user wants instead, in their own words: a product name, a version ("the newest"), or a capability, constraint or market ("supports PCIe 5.0", "automotive-grade", "a European vendor").

product_name.description: The target currently being looked at, e.g. "Samsung Galaxy" — the thing to refine away from.

search_id.description: The search the target came from. Used for the patent context and so the options exclude what is already in the results.

name: claimhit_refine_product
title: Look again at one target
